title: Registratie uitstroom en bestemming schoolverlaters 2002 - RUBS'02 - BVE Monitor
authors: ROA, Researchcentrum voor Onderwijs en Arbeidsmarkt, Universiteit Maastricht (primary investigator)

descriptions: Survey concerning the destinations of graduated and non-graduated school-leavers entering further education and the labour market.
